title: native capability visual and Windows desktop shell

claim.to_prove: The packaged client can make already verified Taiji capabilities observable, accessible, and trustworthy across the window, taskbar, tray, notifications, DPI, and narrow layouts.
claim.must_not_claim: Visual polish, animation, or a logo is not evidence of cognition, provider quality, autonomy, or model scale.

owner.truth_source: native facade capability, health, provider, lineage, workbench, and error projections
forbidden_owners: mock capability fixtures in packaged smoke

output.truth_rule: Every displayed status must be traceable to a server projection or an explicitly static shell property.

trace.privacy: Screenshots and logs must redact tokens, local secrets, prompt content, and full file contents.
trace.determinism: Same package, route, backend revision, and viewport should produce the same capability labels and error states; animation timing is not a capability metric.

limits: no background polling added solely for visual refresh

checkpoint.continuation: Restarted packaged client must rebind to the same server truth source or render a structured unavailable state.

evidence.holdout: Use at least one viewport/DPI combination not used while implementing the layout; use a fresh packaged artifact for final evidence.
evidence.lesion: Remove one native projection or break the backend binding; the UI must show an explicit unavailable/degraded state rather than a mock success.
evidence.cross_seed: Not applicable to static shell pixels; capability labels and revisions must be checked against independent runtime launches.

failure_isolation.backend_unavailable: Render a structured connection/error state and preserve static navigation; never invent capability data.
failure_isolation.shell_failure: Client process may exit or degrade without mutating Taiji checkpoint state.
failure_isolation.notification_failure: Keep in-app state truthful; notification is best-effort presentation only.

rollback.path: revert shell/frontend artifact to the previous package; preserve backend and Taiji checkpoint data
rollback.atomicity: A package is accepted only when frontend bytes and packaged executable evidence refer to the same build digest
rollback.recovery: Restart from the previous verified package and record the visual regression without changing runtime cognition.

implementation.blocker: Windows Computer Use enumerates Seed but cannot activate the captured window; desktop-background screenshots are not accepted as shell evidence.

s2_void_attempts.attempt: packaged client launched from a fresh build on holdout port 8151
s2_void_attempts.void_reason: The bound process exited before any shell evidence was captured, so package digest, port, capability revision and window handle no longer refer to one live observation.
s2_void_attempts.capture_failure_cause: Every screenshot returned the LockApp.exe lock screen; the desktop was never actually unlocked during the attempt.
s2_void_attempts.lesson: Neither input desktop name 'Default' nor a visible Shell_TrayWnd proves an unlocked session, because modern Windows draws the lock screen on the Default desktop. The admissible criterion is the foreground window's owning process: LockApp or LogonUI means not capturable.
s2_void_attempts.resumption_requirement: Any future S2 attempt must rebuild the full binding chain in one live session; no fact from this attempt may be reused.
s2_void_attempts.removal_justification: These captures were blank-window or desktop-background images already rejected as shell evidence and referenced by no report; keeping them invites mistaking a rejected artifact for evidence. The accepted page-layer captures under output/playwright are retained.

boundary: No visual state may be a second source of truth for Taiji or provider state.
No animation may hide an error, alter an action, or imply learning.
Taskbar, tray, and notification identity must use the same static Taiji logo asset and remain recognizable with reduced motion.
